messages:
maria_support: FYI ACME reported 502s from their private endpoints right after we flipped their cert rotation this morning. They say SDKs and some browsers fail TLS verify.
jon_eng: ugh, any error samples from customer?
maria_support: paste from their Node SDK: "Error: certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate". They also included curl -v which shows no intermediate in the chain.
kevin_infra: can you ask for an openssl s_client dump? specifically `openssl s_client -connect vip.acme.internal:443 -showcerts -servername api.acme.internal`
maria_support: they ran that and sent the output. root cert -> server cert only, no intermediate. stack shows OCSP staple present though: `OCSP response: no response sent` was in a few runs.
lisa_oncall: interesting — rotator_bot reported a successful upload and HA reload at 06:12 UTC. rotator_bot: rotation job 2026-03-16T06:12:07Z completed, uploaded bundle id r-8721, verified via AIA fetch during staging.
jon_eng: note: our rotator will attempt AIA fetching to build a chain if bundle is missing an intermediate, but that relies on outbound egress to public AIA URLs. in private/VPC setups that can be blocked. did customer restrict egress?
maria_support: customer says they block almost all outbound except some allowlist, and they didn't have the AIA URLs allowed.
kevin_infra: that matches: rotator succeeded because in our staging (hosted) the AIA fetch worked, we uploaded server cert only to their bucket, and their private VPC couldn't fetch AIA when verifying, so clientside path building failed.
lisa_oncall: so their clients that do AIA fetch (OpenSSL/Node) fail because they can't reach intermediates; browsers might succeed if OS has intermediate cached. explains mixed behavior.
jon_eng: repro steps for us: 1) curl -v --cacert /path/to/ca.pem https://vip.acme.internal/ 2) openssl s_client -showcerts -connect vip.acme.internal:443 -servername api.acme.internal 3) on a host with egress blocked, confirm no AIA fetch possible.
maria_support: customer ran `curl --verbose` and pasted `* Server certificate:` with only server cert lines.
kevin_infra: mitigation: re-upload full chain (server + intermediate(s) in correct order) and re-trigger rotator to push a complete bundle. also ask customer to allow our rotator to hit AIA URLs during rotation or to provide full bundle during rotation call.
jon_eng: quick patch action: add server-side validation in rotator to require a complete chain without relying on remote AIA fetch when target is Private/VPC. fallback should fail rotation and notify support instead of succeeding with incomplete bundle. filing a ticket.
lisa_oncall: created ENG ticket INFRA-1298 to add offline chain validation + error on private endpoints. tagging @jon_eng.
rotator_bot: ticket INFRA-1298 created by lisa_oncall, priority P2.
maria_support: customer requests a fast fix — can we hotfix by re-uploading chain for them?
kevin_infra: we can re-roll their bundle manually. need the intermediate cert file from CA or ask customer to upload. I have CA intermediate; will prepare and push.
jon_eng: also confirm their forward proxy isn't stripping intermediates or reordering chain. ask them to check their proxy (BlueCoat/Envoy) TLS termination config; some proxies strip AIA or modify chain during passthrough.
maria_support: I'll ask them to run `openssl s_client -connect vip.acme.internal:443 -showcerts` from inside the VPC and from a host outside to compare.
kevin_infra: hotfix steps I took: 1) built bundle `cat server.pem intermediate.pem > fullchain.pem` 2) uploaded to their rotator bucket 3) triggered rotation push 4) validated with an internal host that had egress blocked — `openssl s_client` now shows server + intermediate in the handshake.
maria_support: customer confirmed their Node SDK is now connecting. they also said their Java app still failed until they restarted the JVM due to cert cache.
jon_eng: confirm fix and document: immediate customer fix = re-upload full chain + restart apps that cache trust. long-term fix = rotator change to validate/require full chain for private endpoints; update docs to call out egress->AIA requirement.
lisa_oncall: closing loop: customer happy, provided thumbs up. I'll send them a postmortem checklist and the remediation steps.
maria_support: thanks team :thumbsup:
jon_eng: follow-up: I pushed a small validation PR to rotator that checks for intermediate presence and fails on private target if chain incomplete. will link PR in INFRA-1298.
rotator_bot: PR #4523 opened by jon_eng: require-complete-chain-for-private-targets.
kevin_infra: note for runbook: if similar reports pop up, check rotator logs for `AIA fetched` vs `bundle included intermediate`.
maria_support: adding runbook note on support side.
lisa_oncall: resolved — marking thread closed.
